questions.question: Coach buys 4 bats and 1 ball for ₹2050. Later buys 3 bats and 2 balls for ₹1600. Find cost of each bat and ball.
Solve: $2x + 3y = 11$ and $2x - 4y = -24$. Hence find $m$ for which $y = mx + 3$.
Two people 16 km apart walk simultaneously. Walking towards each other they meet in 2 h; same direction they meet in 8 h. Find their speeds.
In $\triangle ABC$, $\angle A = x^{\circ}$, $\angle B = (3x-2)^{\circ}$, $\angle C = y^{\circ}$. Also $\angle C - \angle B = 9^{\circ}$. Determine all three angles.
5 pencils and 7 pens cost ₹50; 7 pencils and 5 pens cost ₹46. Find cost of 1 pencil and 1 pen.
Solve: $(a-b)x + (a+b)y = a^2 - 2ab - b^2$ and $(a+b)(x+y) = a^2 + b^2$
Boat: 32 km upstream + 36 km downstream = 7 hrs. Also 40 km up + 48 km down = 9 hrs. Find speed of boat and stream.
solutionSteps: Solving: $a=1/8, b=1/12 \Rightarrow x-y=8, x+y=12 \Rightarrow x=10, y=2$.

School P: 5 hockey + 4 cricket students = ₹9,500
School Q: 4 hockey + 3 cricket students = ₹7,370

questions.case_study: **PASSAGE:** Nidhi and Riddhi visited a mela. Nidhi: 3 rides on Giant Wheel + 5 on Toy Train = ₹14. Riddhi: 5 rides on Giant Wheel + 3 on Toy Train = ₹18.

parts.i: Form a pair of linear equations.
parts.ii: Cost per ride for Giant Wheel.
parts.iii: (a) Cost per ride for Toy Train and verify. OR (b) Nidhi's cost for 2 rides on each.

questions.case_study: **PASSAGE:** Quiz competition. +4 for correct, -1 for wrong. Team A: 10 questions, score 28. Team B: 12 questions, score 38. Both answered all.

parts.iii: (a) Team A score if 15 questions (same ratio). OR (b) Total correct by both = 13; find each team's correct answers.

solutionSteps: (i) Team A: $4c-w=28, c+w=10$. Team B: $4c-w=38, c+w=12$.
